walkthroughs.title: Get started with Unit File Atlas
walkthroughs.description: Open a sample unit file, see its overview and checks, and try the Pro hardening checklist and reliability review in the free 14-day trial.

steps.title: Open a sample file
steps.description:
Unit File Atlas reads systemd unit files: the [Unit], [Service], [Timer], [Socket] and [Install] sections that tell systemd what to run and when. Open the invented sample service (it has a few deliberate problems) to follow along, or open one of your own unit files.
[Open Sample File](command:unitFileAtlas.openSample)

steps.title: Run Show Unit Overview
steps.description:
What the unit is, its sections, what it depends on and every command it runs. The report opens as a new Markdown document; your file is not changed.
[Show Unit Overview](command:unitFileAtlas.showOverview)

steps.title: Use the other free reports
steps.description:
Every free report works without a key, an account or a network connection: Show Syntax Check, Show Value Check.
[Show Syntax Check](command:unitFileAtlas.showSyntax)
[Show Value Check](command:unitFileAtlas.showValues)

steps.title: Try Pro free for 14 days
steps.description:
The first Pro command you run starts a free 14-day trial on this computer, with no key and no network: Show Service Hardening, Show Reliability Check.
[Show Service Hardening](command:unitFileAtlas.showHardening)

steps.title: Licence and help
steps.description:
Buy Pro (Personal USD 19, Business USD 39 per user), enter a key, see the licence status, or report a problem.
[Show Licence Status](command:unitFileAtlas.licenceStatus)
[Report A Problem](command:unitFileAtlas.reportProblem)

unitFileAtlas.maxFileSizeMB.markdownDescription: Largest file (in MB) a report reads, up to 50 MB (VS Code passes files only up to 50 MB to extensions). Larger files are refused with a message.

unitFileAtlas.openReportsAsPreview.markdownDescription: Open each report in the Markdown preview as well as in a new editor.
